SELECT ma.approval_id, g.group_id, sg.saving_group_id, g.member_id AS applicant_member_id, g.group_name, , r.region_name, CASE WHEN ma.type = 'CREATE' THEN g.created_at ELSE NULL END AS applied_at, ma.status, ma.type, sg.saving_group_type AS group_type, g.max_members, sg.dues_amount, sg.dues_day, g.description, sg.group_image AS group_image_path, ma.reject_reason, ma.request_reason, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN gt.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN gt.amount WHEN gt.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' THEN -gt.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM group_account ga LEFT JOIN group_transaction gt ON gt.account_id = ga.account_id WHERE ga.group_id = g.group_id) AS current_balance, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM saving_group sg2 WHERE sg2.group_id = g.group_id AND sg2.status IN ('02', '03')) AS active_round, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payout_request pr JOIN meeting_round mr ON mr.round_id = pr.round_id WHERE mr.group_id = g.group_id AND pr.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')) AS pending_payout, ma.processed_at FROM meeting_approval ma JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = ma.group_id JOIN saving_group sg ON sg.group_id = g.group_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = g.member_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = g.region_id WHERE ma.approval_id = #{approvalId} AND (g.deleted_at IS NULL OR ma.type = 'DELETE')
AND (ma.type = 'DELETE' OR m.deleted_at IS NULL)
